[Unit]
Description=AtMem private parser host guard
Requires=docker.service
After=docker.service
BindsTo=docker.service
PartOf=docker.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
TimeoutStartSec=60
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/atmem/enterprise_aws_host_bootstrap.py guard ${local.expected_b64}

runcmd:
/usr/bin/python3 -I /opt/atmem/enterprise_aws_host_bootstrap.py prepare ${local.expected_b64}
/usr/bin/systemctl daemon-reload
/usr/bin/systemctl restart docker.service
/usr/bin/systemctl start atmem-document-guard.service
/usr/bin/systemctl unmask --runtime ecs.service
/usr/bin/systemctl enable --now --no-block ecs.service

precondition.error_message: Review this concrete component plan, destination and costs before apply.
The existing worker must match the full same-account ARN, including its path.
Keep parser in its owned regional repository.
Keep transfer in its owned regional repository.
